item.title: Island-Wide Blackout, Economic Growth, Crash Memorial
item.ns0:title: Island-Wide Blackout, Economic Growth, Crash Memorial
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, an islandwide blackout plunges New Providence into darkness, triggering chaos at Lynden Pindling International Airport and prompting an urgent inspection of power plants by the Prime Minister. We explore the latest economic indicators showing steady growth for the first half of the year and investigate a troubling report of a murder suspect who allegedly breached his bail dozens of times. Our team also joins a grieving community for an emotional memorial honoring victims of the tragic Independence Day plane crash and takes you inside a vibrant cultural showcase at the Nassau Cruise Port. Plus, we have the latest updates from the Commonwealth Games and your complete weekend weather forecast as the summer heat persists.
